author: hsliuustc0106
body: Please make the platform scope explicit. A bundled profile is not sufficient on NPU: `NPUARModelRunner.sample_tokens()` fully constructs `OmniModelRunnerOutput` and calls `get_omni_connector_output()` before wrapping it in `AsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput`, so Omni materialization is still synchronous. If this page describes only CUDA/ROCm, say so here and in the compatibility table; if NPU is intended, runtime support/guards are missing. Scoping the docs is the smaller fix for this PR.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: `Omni connector output state` is not snapshotted by the current implementation. `_build_omni_model_runner_output_from_snapshot()` calls `get_omni_connector_output()` in the background, and that method drains live per-step signal sets; the builder also reads `self.requests` during full-payload accumulation. Please remove it from this list and document these live-state ownership/synchronization requirements, or move the connector drain into a synchronous, step-owned snapshot.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: This is not an enforced platform condition: `_should_use_async_omni_output()` has no platform check, XPU inherits `GPUARModelRunner`, and MUSA selects `GPUARWorker`. They can take the background path when the remaining conditions pass. Please describe CUDA/ROCm as validation scope only, or add a guard; otherwise the fallback promise is incorrect.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: The enabled async path cannot perform full-payload accumulation: async output requires `async_chunk`, while `should_accumulate_full_payload_output()` returns false whenever `async_chunk` is enabled. Please replace this with the streaming payload handoff, or label it as synchronous-only.

The architecture section now explains that the shared full-payload branch reads `self.requests` but is unreachable for this feature because async Omni output requires `async_chunk`, which makes `should_accumulate_full_payload_output()` return `False`; the enabled path partitions each step into streaming inter-stage and client handoffs.

body: Not currently. I made this explicit in `50126edf`: `_should_use_async_omni_output()` returns `False` whenever `self.omni_prefix_cache` is present, so enabling Omni prefix caching selects synchronous output materialization. Supporting both requires snapshotting or otherwise synchronizing prefix-cache merge and update state before the background builder can consume it safely.
